case_metadata.title: Case 2: Delphouse Rd / Cheadle Rural Crossroad T-Bone
case_metadata.subtitle: BX21 TKP (Range Rover Evoque) vs MK18 PZR (Ford Focus ST-Line — Multi-Cam)

agentic_video_scrub_steps.summary: Pass 1 (Dual-Camera Temporal Synchronisation): Aligned Cam 1 (Ego Dashcam in MK18 PZR, 122° FOV) with Cam 2 (Farmhouse Gate Static CCTV, 105° FOV, +0.12s offset). Stripped 2 non-causal background agricultural objects while retaining both colliding vehicles and high hawthorn hedgerow splays.

Pass 2 (High-FPS Crossroad Approach t=0.25s..1.35s): Tracked BX21 TKP (Range Rover Evoque) approaching Southbound on Delphouse Rd minor arm at 28.4 mph, braking late at t=0.75s with thin front brake pads and entering the priority crossroad at 21.8 mph. Tracked MK18 PZR (Ford Focus) approaching Eastbound at 46.0 mph past a Crossroads Hazard Warning sign (Diagram 504.1).

Pass 3 (DVSA Causal vs Non-Causal Audit): Flagged MK18 PZR's DVSA rear brake disc advisory [1.1.14 (a) (i)] as NOT CAUSAL because MK18 PZR was struck broadside on its nearside flank while traversing the crossroad, whereas BX21 TKP's thin front brake pads [1.1.13 (a) (ii)] and 2.0mm nearside front tyre are flagged CAUSAL to its overshoot across the Give Way line.

physics_audit_log:
ANTIGRAVITY SANDBOX KINEMATIC VERIFICATION (`antigravity-preview-09-2026` | `gemini-4-argon`):
1. RURAL CROSSROAD SIGHTLINE TRIANGLE & STOPPING ENVELOPE (μ = 0.58 DAMP COUNTRY LANE):
   - High hawthorn hedgerows restricted diagonal crossroad visibility splay to 21.5m.
   - BX21 TKP (2,090 kg Range Rover Evoque) approached the Diagram 1003 Give Way line at 28.4 mph (12.70 m/s) and braked late at t=0.75s; thin front brake pads (DVSA 1.1.13(a)(ii)) and 2.0mm N/S front tyre tread prevented stopping short of the line, entering the junction box at 21.8 mph.
   - MK18 PZR (1,395 kg Ford Focus) approached the signed crossroad hazard at 46.0 mph (20.56 m/s) instead of moderating speed to ~35 mph under Highway Code Rule 146, resulting in a 65% Defendant / 35% Claimant liability apportionment.

report.incident_summary: At 11:08 BST at the rural Delphouse Road crossroad outside Cheadle (Staffordshire Moorlands), a 2021 Silver Land Rover Range Rover Evoque (BX21 TKP, Vehicle A) approached Southbound on the minor Delphouse Road arm at 28.4 mph, failed to yield at the Diagram 1003 Give Way line despite high hawthorn hedgerows obscuring lateral sightlines to 21.5m, and overshot into the intersection at 21.8 mph despite late braking at t=0.75s. Simultaneously, a 2018 Red Ford Focus ST-Line (MK18 PZR, Vehicle B) approached Eastbound along the priority rural carriageway at 46.0 mph without moderating speed in response to an advance Diagram 504.1 Crossroads Warning Sign. BX21 TKP struck the nearside flank of MK18 PZR at (x=0.4m, z=0.1m) at t=1.25s, spinning MK18 PZR 64° clockwise and tipping BX21 TKP to a 34.0° peak roll angle onto the verge.

report.stopping_distance_analysis: Under Highway Code Rules 125, 126, and 146, the national 60 mph limit on an unlit rural lane is an absolute maximum, not a safe target at a blind crossroad with a 21.5m visibility splay. At MK18 PZR's approach speed of 46.0 mph (20.56 m/s) on damp rural tarmac (mu = 0.58), total stopping distance is 50.9m (13.8m thinking + 37.1m braking), exceeding the 21.5m sightline splay by 29.4m. Meanwhile, BX21 TKP approached the Give Way line at 28.4 mph and braked only 6.8m before the line (t=0.75s), where DVSA-recorded thin front brake pads and a 2.0mm nearside front tyre prevented stopping outside the priority corridor.
report.causal_filtering_summary: Stripped 2 non-causal background objects (1 stationary agricultural tractor parked inside a gated field 45m north and 1 distant telegraph pole) while preserving both colliding vehicles (BX21 TKP & MK18 PZR), the Diagram 1003 Give Way line, the Diagram 504.1 Crossroads warning sign, and the sightline-blocking hawthorn hedgerows.

scene_environment_elements.label: Delphouse Rd Give Way Sign (TSRGD Diagram 602)
scene_environment_elements.causal_relevance_note: Required BX21 TKP to yield priority and creep forward given the obstructed hawthorn hedgerow sightline.
scene_environment_elements.statutory_duty: Road Traffic Act 1988 s.36 & Highway Code Rule 172: Mandatory obligation on minor-road traffic to give way to all traffic on the priority crossroad.
scene_environment_elements.driver_compliance: BREACHED by BX21 TKP (approached at 28.4 mph, braked late at t=0.75s, and overshot the Give Way line at 21.8 mph into the priority lane).
scene_environment_elements.legal_liability_impact: Establishes primary statutory liability (65% fault) against BX21 TKP under Harding v Hinchcliffe [1964] RTR 112.

scene_environment_elements.label: Delphouse Rd Double Broken Give Way Line (TSRGD Diagram 1003)
scene_environment_elements.causal_relevance_note: Transverse double dashed priority line crossed by BX21 TKP at t=1.00s (24.6 mph) due to late braking and thin front brake pads.
scene_environment_elements.statutory_duty: Highway Code Rule 172 & TSRGD Schedule 9 Part 6: Vehicles must not cross the transverse double broken line unless the priority road is clear.
scene_environment_elements.driver_compliance: BREACHED by BX21 TKP (crossed at t=1.00s at 24.6 mph into the Eastbound path of MK18 PZR).
scene_environment_elements.legal_liability_impact: Corroborates physical encroachment into the priority corridor prior to impact at t=1.25s.

scene_environment_elements.label: UK Diagram 504.1 Crossroads Hazard Warning Sign
scene_environment_elements.causal_relevance_note: Alerted MK18 PZR on the priority rural road to moderate speed below 46.0 mph under Highway Code Rule 146.
scene_environment_elements.statutory_duty: Highway Code Rules 125 & 146: Advance warning of a rural crossroad hazard requiring priority-road drivers to adapt speed to restricted corner visibility.
scene_environment_elements.driver_compliance: BREACHED by MK18 PZR (maintained 46.0 mph past the warning sign despite a 21.5m hedgerow visibility splay requiring a 50.9m wet stopping distance).
scene_environment_elements.legal_liability_impact: Fixes 35% contributory negligence on MK18 PZR under Harding v Hinchcliffe [1964] RTR 112 and Macintyre v Coles [1966] 1 WLR 831.

scene_environment_elements.label: 2.4m Uncut Hawthorn Hedgerow (Northwest Corner)
scene_environment_elements.causal_relevance_note: Severely restricted mutual diagonal sightline between Southbound and Eastbound approaches to 21.5m.
scene_environment_elements.tsrgd_diagram: Highways Act 1980 s.79 (Corner Visibility Splay Obstruction)
scene_environment_elements.statutory_duty: Highway Code Rules 126 & 170: Both drivers must adjust approach speed so they can stop well within the distance they can see to be clear.
scene_environment_elements.driver_compliance: BREACHED by both BX21 TKP (failed to creep to the Give Way splay) and MK18 PZR (Stopping distance 50.9m > 21.5m sightline).
scene_environment_elements.legal_liability_impact: Explains mutual late hazard perception and supports the 65% Defendant / 35% Claimant split.

forensic_events.description: MK18 PZR passes Diagram 504.1 Crossroads Warning Sign at 46.0 mph; BX21 TKP approaches Delphouse Rd Give Way line at 28.4 mph.
2.4m hawthorn hedgerow blocks diagonal sightline between approaches until 21.5m separation.
Both drivers initiate emergency braking at t=0.75s; BX21 TKP's thin front brake pads and 2.0mm N/S front tyre prevent stopping before the line.
BX21 TKP crosses Delphouse Rd Diagram 1003 Give Way line at 24.1 mph into the priority lane.
Broadside T-bone impact at (x=0.4m, z=0.1m): BX21 TKP strikes MK18 PZR nearside doors, inducing 34.0° verge roll on BX21 TKP and 64° yaw spin on MK18 PZR.

primary_highway_code_rules_breached: Highway Code Rule 172 & Rule 170: BX21 TKP failed to give way at the Delphouse Rd Diagram 1003 double broken white lines.
Highway Code Rule 125 & Rule 146: MK18 PZR failed to reduce speed below 46.0 mph when approaching a signed blind rural crossroad (Diagram 504.1) on damp tarmac.

case_law_citations.legal_principle: Where a minor-road driver fails to yield at a controlled junction but the priority driver approaches an obscured intersection at excessive speed, a two-thirds / one-third (65% / 35%) split applies.
case_law_citations.application_to_crash: Assigns 65% primary fault to BX21 TKP for overshooting the Give Way line and 35% contributory fault to MK18 PZR for ignoring the crossroads warning sign at 46.0 mph.
case_law_citations.policy_section_ref: Policy #UK-8841 Section 6 Clause 6.3 (65% / 35% Rural Crossroad Split Liability Band)

case_law_citations.legal_principle: Priority on a main road is qualified by the duty to travel at a speed suited to restricted junction sightlines.
case_law_citations.application_to_crash: Supports 35% deduction against MK18 PZR given the 21.5m hawthorn hedgerow sightline limit.

report.legal_reasoning_chain:
1. PRIMARY BREACH (65% DEFENDANT — BX21 TKP): BX21 TKP approached a blind rural Give Way junction at 28.4 mph and braked too late (t=0.75s) with CAUSAL thin front brake pads and a 2.0mm nearside front tyre, overshooting into the priority corridor.
2. CONTRIBUTORY NEGLIGENCE & NON-CAUSAL DVSA EXCLUSION (35% CLAIMANT — MK18 PZR): MK18 PZR approached a signed blind crossroad (Diagram 504.1) at 46.0 mph on damp rural macadam in breach of Highway Code Rules 125 and 146, warranting a 35% deduction under Harding v Hinchcliffe [1964]. Notably, MK18 PZR's DVSA advisory for worn rear brake discs (`1.1.14 (a) (i)`) is explicitly classified as NOT CAUSAL because MK18 PZR was struck broadside on its nearside flank.
